title: App-shell template cannot attach www to a reader app domain
description: The Pilobol.us cutover needs the new reader app (dssc97s4q5kgk) to serve both pilobol.us and www.pilobol.us (branch main). addReaderApp in infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/amplify-app-shell.ts creates the domain association with only prefix "" (apex); site.json has no way to add www. Fix at template level: optional reader.includeWww boolean; apex+www subDomainSettings both on the reader branch; unchanged when unset. Add synth and site-config tests, README and docs updates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/140 (not merged). Adds `reader.includeWww` (boolean, requires `reader.domainName`). CI green.

right_now_summary: A pull request adds optional `reader.includeWww` support, with tests and documentation updates, but it awaits merge.
